description: Time will always reveal the truth. Be patient, aware and pay attention to the details #selflove #selfimprovement #criticalthinking
transcript: Allow time to do the talking. The more that I sit in a state of observation, I'm able to see people, places and things for what they are. I see their habits, I see their inconsistencies, I see their patterns. The more that I sit in that, I understand that I'm not required to do any heavy lifting in order to see what's in front of me. Everything will reveal itself over time.
